meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 让 Claude 能通过命令行启动并操控浏览器:打开网址、查看可点击/可输入元素、点击、填表、截图、取文字等,并把结果带回来。
howto.when: 当用户需要访问网站、操作网页、填表、截图、测试网页或提取网页信息时。

say.text: 打开 example.com,列出页面上所有按钮
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并返回可点击元素清单。

say.text: 在邮箱框输入 test@test.com,再点提交按钮
say.note: 会执行填表并点击,然后反馈结果。

say.text: 给当前页面截图并保存为截图.png
say.note: 会截取当前页面并保存到文件。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to drive a browser via command line: open URLs, snapshot interactive elements, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and return results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to browse websites, interact with pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web apps, or extract page data.

say_en.text: Open example.com and list all buttons on the page
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and return a list of clickable elements.

say_en.text: Fill the email field with test@test.com and click Submit
say_en.note: Fills the form and clicks, then reports the outcome.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page and save it as screenshot.png
say_en.note: Captures the page and saves it to a file.
